# Copy-able color palettes, built for R.
:::

::: {style="max-width:640px;color:#555;font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:2rem;"}
Pick a module, pick a few options, and walk away with a hex list ready to paste into `scale_fill_manual()`.

Let *Palette Jack* do the heavy lifting.
:::


```{r}
#| label: mode-preview-swatches
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

werner <- read_csv("data/werner-colors.csv")
woods_hole <- read_csv("data/woods-hole-palettes.csv")
wada <- read_csv("data/sanzo_wada_colors_long.csv")

mini_swatches <- function(hexes) {
  paste(glue('<span class="mini-swatch" style="background:{hexes}"></span>'), collapse = "")
}

# one representative color per classification, for a quick landing-page preview
werner_preview <- werner |>
  filter(group %in% c("Blue", "Green", "Red", "Yellow", "Purple")) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pull(hex) |>
  mini_swatches()

# the Atlantis palette, as a representative Woods Hole preview
wh_preview <- woods_hole |>
  filter(palette == "atlantis") |>
  arrange(position) |>
  pull(hex) |>
  mini_swatches()

# one representative 4-color combo, base + its 3 matched colors, for a
# quick landing-page preview
wada_preview_name <- wada |>
  count(color_name, name = "n_matches") |>
  filter(n_matches == 3) |>
  arrange(color_name) |>
  slice(1) |>
  pull(color_name)

wada_preview_df <- wada |>
  filter(color_name == wada_preview_name) |>
  arrange(combo_index)

wada_preview <- mini_swatches(c(wada_preview_df$color_hex[1], wada_preview_df$combo_hex))

# Oceanography preview: one representative palette (Jason)
ocean <- read_csv("data/oceanography-colors.csv")

ocean_preview <- ocean |>
  filter(palette == "jason") |>
  arrange(position) |>
  pull(hex) |>
  mini_swatches()

# Aggieland preview: primary palette
aggieland <- read_csv("data/aggieland-colors.csv")

aggieland_preview <- aggieland |>
  filter(palette == "primary") |>
  arrange(position) |>
  pull(hex) |>
  mini_swatches()

# IPA preview: one representative palette
imperial_ale <- read_csv("data/imperial-pale-ale-colors.csv")

imperial_preview <- imperial_ale |>
  filter(palette == "zilker") |>
  arrange(position) |>
  pull(hex) |>
  mini_swatches()
```

## Modes

::::::: mode-grid
::: mode-card
### [Werner](werner/index.qmd)

Randomize a capped, classification-filtered set of colors from an 1814 historical color reference.

`r werner_preview`
:::

::: mode-card
### [Wada](wada/index.qmd)

2-, 3-, and 4-color combinations from Sanzo Wada’s 1933 Dictionary of Color Combinations.

`r wada_preview`
:::

::: mode-card
### [Woods Hole](woods-hole/index.qmd)

20 hand-picked palettes inspired by Woods Hole, Falmouth, and WHOI.

`r wh_preview`
:::

::: mode-card
### [Oceanography](oceanography/index.qmd)

Research vessel and oceanographic survey palettes — Jason, Atlantis, Alvin, and more.

`r ocean_preview`
:::

::: mode-card
### [Aggieland](aggieland/index.qmd)

Texas A&M University's brand palette — Aggie Maroon, secondary neutrals, and accent shades.

`r aggieland_preview`
:::

::: mode-card
### [IPA](imperial-pale-ale/index.qmd)

Color palettes pulled from craft beer labels and coasters.

`r imperial_preview`
:::
